detail.longDescription: For anyone interested, I made an `<idempotency-key />` web-component. https:// github.com/tobz-nz/web-compone nts/blob/main/idempotency/idempotency.js This WC generates a SHA-256 hash of all a forms’ input data (including file contents) and adds the hash to the form data - allowing you to implement an Idempotency check server-side - only process the same request once regardless of how many times its submitted. Properly fix those pesky double click form submissions! https:// cloud.google.com/discover/idem potency # webdev # webcomponents
